subject: Overworld
text: In the overworld view you will not be attacked.

evidence.quote: In the overworld view you will not be attacked.

subject: Overworld Controls
text: In overworld view, the Directional-Pad moves up, down, left, and right, the A Button talks or acquires things, and the B Button has no use.

evidence.quote:
OVERWORLD VIEW CONTROLS

    Directional-Pad: Move up, down, left, and right.
    A BUTTON: Talk or Acquire things
    B BUTTON: No use

subject: Dungeon Controls
text: In dungeon view, the Directional-Pad moves up, down, left, right, and diagonally, the A Button jumps, the B Button uses the current weapon, Start pauses, and Select switches weapons.

evidence.quote:
DUNGEON VIEW CONTROLS

    Directional-Pad: Move up, down, left, right, and diagonally.
    A BUTTON: JUMP
    B BUTTON: USE CURRENT WEAPON
    START: PAUSE
    SELECT: SWITCH WEAPON

subject: Dr. J
text: If you answer NO when asked if you understand, Dr. J will state to reverse the wording, so answer YES.

evidence.quote:
If you answer NO he will
    simply state to you the obvious that you reverse the wording so
    just say YES even though it still doesn't make sense.

subject: Dimensional Gate
text: Mike reads Paapaapaaoompapamowmow from the Oxford Wonder World book, which causes a dimensional gate to open and Mike to get sucked into it.

evidence.quote:
He instructs Mike to get him the 
    Oxford Wonder World book....Paapaapaaoompapamowmow is read by Mike before his
    uncle can tell him to stop. This causes the book to open and
    its pages to turn really quickly. Suddenly we see a dimensonal
    gate open and Mike get sucked into it.

subject: Chapter 2: ICE AGE
text: You can only head North across the snow, where a cave man warns that the ground has random holes you can fall into.

evidence.quote:
You can only 
    head North at this point so head in that direction. You will 
    find a cave man that will tell you that the ground has holes and
    to be careful. As far as I can tell these holes are random so just 
    be prepared to fall into a few of them as you cross this snow.

subject: Random Dungeon A
text: In Room 3 of Random Dungeon A, there are five boars, a salamander, and some rocks to grab.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are five boars here and a salamander, but most importantly 
    are some rocks. Grab the rocks and kill what you must.

subject: Random Dungeon A
text: Room 4 of Random Dungeon A exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    Exit back to overworld.

subject: Random Dungeon B
text: In Room 2 of Random Dungeon B, there are four boars and some rocks to grab.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are four boars here, and there are some rocks. 
    Grab the rocks and do you must to get to ROOM #3.

subject: Random Dungeon B
text: Room 3 of Random Dungeon B exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    Exit back to overworld.

subject: Random Dungeon C
text: In Room 2 of Random Dungeon C, there are two boars and some rocks to grab.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are two boars here, and there are some rocks. 
    Grab the rocks and do you must to get to ROOM #3.

subject: Random Dungeon C
text: In Room 3 of Random Dungeon C, there are no enemies, just hearts to collect while being careful not to fall in the water.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are no enemies here. Just hearts to collect. Be
    careful to not fall in the water.

subject: Random Dungeon C
text: In Room 4 of Random Dungeon C, kill the blue bear with stones to open the path to Room 5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There is a blue bear here. Quickly kill him with your
    stones and the path will open up to ROOM #5.

subject: Random Dungeon C
text: Room 5 of Random Dungeon C exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    Exit back to overworld.

subject: Pikazo
text: Visit Pikazo in Cave Men Cave and write down the drawings seen on his wall.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you 
    visit Pikazo and write down the drawings you see on his wall.

subject: Tink
text: Visit Tink over by a large pile of bones in Cave Men Cave to receive an Axe he has made.

evidence.quote:
Also, visit Tink over by a large pile of bones. He has an Axe
    that he has made that he will give you.

subject: Prophet
text: The prophet in Cave Men Cave asks if you are the one, and tells you to head to the cave and defeat Yum Yum.

evidence.quote:
Continue your way through the cave and find the prophet who
    prophesized your coming. He will ask you if you are the one.
    Regardless of what you answer he will tell you to head to the 
    cave and defeat Yum Yum.

subject: Cave Men Cave
text: After exiting Cave Men Cave to the overworld, continue North until you find another cave entrance.

evidence.quote:
Once you exit the cave and return to the overworld view continue
    North until you find another cave entrance.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 2 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the 4 boars to open a wall to the North leading to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are 4 boars in here. You must defeat them and once you do a 
    wall will open to the North allowing you to ROOM #3.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 3 of Yum Yum Cave, kill the salamanders on the right to hear a wall open, then take the northern opening on the left to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are several boars in this room. Make your way to the right 
    and kill the salamanders. You will hear a wall open. If you walk 
    back to the left you will see an opening to the North. Take this 
    to ROOM #4.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 4 of Yum Yum Cave, take the medicine and go back to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There is nothing here but a medicine. Just take it and go back to 
    ROOM #3.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 5 of Yum Yum Cave, ignore the two salamanders and continue right to Room 6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    There are two salamanders here but ignore them continuing right to 
    ROOM #6.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 6 of Yum Yum Cave, ignore the four boars and go north to Room 7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are four boars here but ignore them as well and go north to 
    ROOM #7.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 7 of Yum Yum Cave, jump to the little island and jump south until making your way back to Room 6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There is a blue bear that you should kill quickly. You can ignore it 
    however and proceed to jump to the little island and then head jump 
    south until we make our way back to ROOM #6.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: From Room 7, move around the corners of Room 6 and Room 5 until reaching Room 8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6 & #5 (from ROOM #7):
    Just move around the corners of these rooms until you make your way 
    to ROOM #8.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 8 of Yum Yum Cave, jump across ledges to the far left, killing two boars along the way, then proceed left and go north to Room 9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are four boars here but ignore the two on the bottom. You need 
    to jump across these ledges until you make it all the way to the far 
    left. Killing two boars along the way.Proceed left and go north to 
    ROOM #9.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 9 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the three blue bears to open the door North to Room 11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    There are three blue bears that you need to defeat to open the door 
    to the North. Once you have defeated them you can go North to ROOM 
    #11.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 10 of Yum Yum Cave, there are three boars, and you proceed North to Room 11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    There are just three boars here. You can kill them if you wish but 
    in either case proceed North to ROOM #11.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 11 of Yum Yum Cave, head right past the walking snow men to find a room going North to Room 12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    There are several walking snow men in this room. Head right, you 
    don't have to defeat the snow men but it is easier if you do. 
    Eventually you will see a room going North to ROOM #12.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 12 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the yellow bear if you must and continue North to Room 13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    This room has a yellow bear in it. Defeat it if you must and then 
    continue North to ROOM #13.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 13 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the three yellow bears to open the door to the North leading to Room 14.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    This room has three yellow bears. In this room you must defeat them 
    to open the door to the North taking you to ROOM #14.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 14 of Yum Yum Cave, follow the exits matching the drawing sequence: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14:
    This is the maze section and the reason I asked you to scribble down 
    the drawings on the wall back at the cave men cave. If you didn't 
    write it down it was: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, 
    square, triangle. Just follow the exit to the room closest to the 
    symbol and you should get through this maze no problem.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 15 of Yum Yum Cave, proceed to the East past the four snow men to enter Room 16.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #15:
    There are four snow men in this room but you can skip them if you'd 
    like and proceed to the East and taking you to ROOM #16.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: In Room 16 of Yum Yum Cave, there are six boars, and you proceed North to Room 17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #16:
    There are just six boars here. You can kill them if you wish but in 
    either case proceed North to ROOM #17.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Yum Yum goes down after about 30 axes while avoiding the burped bubbles, opening the door East to Room 18.

evidence.quote:
If you do have to battle with him just make sure to avoid the 
    bubbles he burps at you and keep throwing axes his way. He should go 
    down after about 30 axes and the door to the East and Room #18 will 
    open up.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Do not attack the boar next to Yum Yum, because Yum Yum will eat the boar and continue to ignore you, but attacking it will make him engage immediately.

evidence.quote:
Do not attack the boar that is 
    next to him. Yum Yum will eat this boar and continue to ignore you, 
    but if you kill this boar he will immediately engage you in combat.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: Room 18 of Yum Yum Cave has an exit to the North.

evidence.quote:
Room #18:
    There is an exit to the North.

subject: Back of Yum Yum Cave
text: Head North and East in the cave to pick up a Block that is one of the mystic tetrads, which also increases your life total to seven hearts.

evidence.quote:
Continue North and then East until you 
    find a Block and then proceed out of the cave....Mike then 
    realizes the Block he just picked up in the cave is one of these 
    tetrads. As a bonus you increase your life total to seven hearts.

subject: Time Travel
text: Mike recites PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW from the Oxford World Wonder to flip pages and travel to another time period.

evidence.quote:
Unsure what to do now, Mike consults the Oxford World Wonder again. 
    Mike recites the words:
    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW. 
    This flips the pages again and sends Mike to another time period.
